title: Consolidation: Global Hungarians: Émigré Waves & Returnees

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the historical trajectories of Hungarian emigration from 1890 to the present day.
I can fluently employ figurative and aspectual preverbs (beilleszkedik, elvándorol, hazatelepül, átörökít, újrakezd) across various discursive contexts.
I can discuss the cultural, demographic, and economic linkages connecting the global diaspora to Hungary.
